resources.string: This is a demonstration of different scenarios of working with background audio. All these buttons play the sound in the background, but they do it differently. All these buttons will background your app, request audio focus and play the sound, changing the volume up and down.
To see audio focus change, play some other audio in the background or in PiP mode.
This should be allowed on your device
This button will try to play background sound directly
This is restricted on Android 17 onwards
Play audio in service without while-in-use capabilities
This button will try to play background sound in a separate service, which is allowed in new Androids
